info.name: Webex Admin Address Book PSTN API
Retrieve PSTN Connection Options for a Location

params.name: locationId
params.description: Return the list of List PSTN location connection options for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: List PSTN location connection options for this organization.

params.name: serviceTypes
params.description:
Use the `serviceTypes` parameter to fetch connections for the following services
* `MOBILE_NUMBERS`

items.docs:
Retrieve the list of PSTN connection options available for a location.

PSTN location connection settings enables the admin to configure or change the PSTN provider for a location.

Retrieving this list requires a full or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_pstn_read`.

info.name: Retrieve PSTN Connection for a Location

params.name: locationId
params.description: Retrieve PSTN location connection details for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Retrieve PSTN location connection details for this organization.

items.docs:
Retrieves the current configured PSTN connection details for a location.

PSTN location connection settings enables the admin to configure or change the PSTN provider for a location.

Retrieving the PSTN connection details for a location requires a full or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_pstn_read`.

info.name: Setup PSTN Connection for a Location

params.name: locationId
params.description: Setup PSTN location connection options for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Setup PSTN location connection for this organization.

items.docs:
Set up or update the PSTN connection details for a location.

PSTN location connection settings enables the admin to configure or change the PSTN provider for a location.

Setting up PSTN connection on a location requires a full administrator auth token with scopes of `spark-admin:telephony_pstn_write` and `spark-admin:telephony_pstn_read`.

info.name: Update the Emergency Address for a Phone Number

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: Update the emergency address for this phone number.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Update the emergency address of phone number in this organization.

items.docs:
Update the emergency address for a phone number.

Emergency address settings allow the admin to configure or update the physical address associated with a phone number or a location.

Updating the emergency address for a phone number requires a full administrator auth token with scope of `spark-admin:telephony_pstn_write`.

info.name: Emergency Address Lookup to Verify if Address is Valid

params.name: locationId
params.description: Emergency address lookup for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Emergency address lookup for this organization.

items.docs:
Returns a suggested address. If the input address is valid and unchanged, no errors are returned. If the input address requires corrections, the response includes a suggested address along with error details.

Emergency address settings allow the admin to configure or update the physical address associated with a phone number or a location.

Emergency address lookup to verify if address is valid requires a full administrator auth token with scope of `spark-admin:telephony_pstn_read`.

info.name: Add an Emergency Address to a Location

params.name: locationId
params.description: Location to which the emergency address will be added.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Adding emergency address for a location in this organization.

items.docs:
Adds a new emergency address to the specified location. On success, returns the unique identifier of the newly created emergency address.

Emergency address settings allow the admin to configure or update the physical address associated with a phone number or a location.

Adding emergency address to a location requires a full administrator auth token with scope of `spark-admin:telephony_pstn_write`.

info.name: Update the Emergency Address of a Location

params.name: locationId
params.description: Location for which the emergency address will be updated.

params.name: addressId
params.description: Unique identifier for the emergency address that will be updated.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Updating the emergency address of a location in this organization.

items.docs:
Updates the emergency address of the specified location.

Emergency address settings allow the admin to configure or update the physical address associated with a phone number or a location.

Updating the emergency address of a location requires a full administrator auth token with scope of `spark-admin:telephony_pstn_write`.
